currentPage.title: Missions
currentPage.seoDescription: We are dedicated to bringing hope and healing to people everywhere. See how you play a key role in relief and restoration work through our Global and Local Mission Partners.

0.headingText: Bringing hope and healing to people everywhere.

02.content:
We’re dedicated to bringing hope and healing to people everywhere by caring for their physical, spiritual, and relational needs—just like Jesus did. We support strategically-selected organizations in our communities and around the world to partner with God in the work He’s already doing.

With your help, we can reach people of every age, location, and language for Christ.

0.content: We’re committed to translating the Bible, helping communities access clean water, rescuing victims of human trafficking, and more.
0.title: Global Missions

00.content: By investing in Local Mission Partners, we help empower our communities, strengthen families, and stand against injustice.
00.title: Local Missions

0.title: How can I learn more about Life.Church’s Global Partners?
0.content: Visit our Global Missions page to find a list of our partners. For more information, visit their websites, check out their social media accounts, and see if they have volunteer opportunities available.

00.content:
In our communities, we strategically select Local Mission Partners that are transforming our cities in five key areas: families, well-being, education, justice, and community empowerment.

Globally, we partner with organizations who specialize in translating the Bible, helping communities access clean water, rescuing victims of human trafficking, and much more.
00.title: Which causes does Life.Church support?

01.content: You can get involved by volunteering with a Local Mission Partner, giving to Local & Global Missions, signing up for our missions email updates, and joining us in prayer.
01.title: How can I get involved?

02.title: How will being a part of missions efforts build my faith?
02.content: Following Jesus’ example helps us live more like Him. When you use your time, talents, and resources to show God’s love to others, it doesn’t just impact the people around you—it impacts you, too.

03.title: Does Life.Church do missions trips?
03.content:
Instead of organizing missions trips, Life.Church focuses on supporting trusted Global Mission Partners who have expertise in key areas. Resources like Becoming Whole have deepened our understanding of poverty and shaped our approach to global missions—we strongly recommend it!

When you give to Local & Global Missions, you can be confident you’re joining some of the best in the world to do what God’s called each of us to do.

04.content: Let us know, and we’ll make sure the right person on our team gets back to you.
04.title: What if I have a question about Life.Church’s Global Partners?

0.headingText: The Latest from Local & Global Missions
Get Monthly Missions Updates in Your Inbox

00.headingText: Enter your email to receive inspiring stories and prayer requests from our partners, hear about ways you can get involved, and more.

00.subTitle: February 2026
00.title: Missions Update
00.content: When Bobby was discharged after open-heart surgery during a winter storm, he had nowhere to heal. His story shows why City Care's new Medical Respite Center will transform how Oklahoma City cares for its most vulnerable neighbors.
